claims.statement: Tom Allen was charged with killing Timothy Confoy (printed Con-foy) in a saloon at the corner of Seventh and Market streets on February 20, 1899.
claims.excerpt: charged with the killing of Timothy Con- foy, in a saloon at the corner of Seventh _ and Market streets, Feb. 20, 1899
places: Seventh and Market streets, St. Louis

claims.statement: The state dismissed the case against Tom Allen for the killing of Timothy Confoy in Judge Fisher's court, the evidence being insufficient.
claims.excerpt: His Case Dismissed by the State in Judge Fisher’s Court, the Evid-ence Being Insufficient.

claims.statement: The newspaper describes Tom Allen as an ex-pugilist.
claims.excerpt: The case against Tom Allen, ex-pugiilist, charged with the killing of Timothy Con- foy

notes: Short court item. The dismissal was on a Tuesday; the paper is dated 1899-11-14, a Tuesday. OCR damage kept as printed.
